items.caption:
Dario Amodei says Anthropic chose enterprise customers on purpose, because of safety.

His reasoning: enterprises care about safety more than consumers do, so selling to businesses fits Anthropic’s focus on building AI carefully.

Is safety a real selling point for AI, or do buyers just want the best model?

Source: Bloomberg Television, Anthropic’s Amodei Doesn’t Want AI Agents to ‘Run Wild’. Full video: youtube.com/watch?v=jbvHYx9aQ6k

items.caption:
Mark Zuckerberg put cameras in his gym so an AI can coach him between rounds.

It watches the footage while he trains and gives feedback in the one-minute break. He says that is a hard problem: it has to process all the video fast enough to fit that minute.

Would you trust an AI coach over a human one?

Source: Cheeky Pint, Zuckerberg’s $100 Billion Bet. Full video: youtube.com/watch?v=XfdIhd1g6EI

items.caption:
Mark Zuckerberg says Meta was ready to write a $100 billion to $200 billion check before it had even seen the models.

At the end of last year the team was excited about the progress, but they had not seen the models yet. So he turned to Alexandr Wang and asked: are you sure this is going to work?

Would you bet that much on a model you had not seen yet?
